description_en: Saves output details in batch as personal resources. Supports link or copy mode
description_zh: 将产出明细批量保存为个人资源，支持链接或复制模式
name: SaveOutputFileToResource

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. In winnexo-cli, pass it explicitly with --tenant-id
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 --tenant-id 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en:
The save mode. Valid values:
link: Links the resource to the output in a 1:1 idempotent manner. Edits to the output are synchronized to the resource.
copy: Creates a snapshot copy with no limit on the number of copies
parameters.help_zh: 保存方式：link=链接（1:1 幂等，编辑产出会同步资源） / copy=复制（不限次，快照）
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target personal folder. If not specified, the user's default folder is automatically resolved
parameters.help_zh: 目标个人目录 ID；不传则自动解析用户默认目录
parameters.name: directory_id
